context:
Goal: batch merges do not stall on prompts.
Problem (rule): the "Merge Tool Read Checks" allow rule in settings.json names three read flags, so auto mode may ask the batch runner before each new `--batch-build`, `--batch-drop` and `--ready` from #2378. A settings write needs your word.
Based on (read): the lane's report on #2378.
Departs from: main's allow rule names three read flags — it would add the three batch flags.
Meanwhile: #2378 goes on to the batch runner as is; the runner answers any prompt it meets.

options.how: One settings edit adds `--batch-build`, `--batch-drop` and `--ready` to the allow rule.
options.label: Add the three flags
options.lose: Auto mode no longer asks before these batch acts. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.

options.gain: Each batch act gets a human look.
options.label: Keep the ask
options.lose: The batch runner can stall on a prompt until someone answers.

ref: #2378 (head 4b714a03f); settings.json autoMode.allow entry "Merge Tool Read Checks"
reply: You picked a on the page at 13:09 CST Nov 9. Home: roadmap step batch-freeze-lane-set-enforce, which lands the settings change.
short: Allow the three new batch flags without asking?
title: Should the merge tool's allow rule in settings.json also cover the three new batch flags from #2378, so the batch runner is not asked before each batch step?
